title: Divergence: proof-backends.md §4 exported form leaves rbody UNBOUND — result-binding lacks the stabilization quantifier; the fuel-hint rendering is unsound (PinStabilization Pin A)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Kernel-checked pin: lean/Thermite/PinStabilization.lean (Pin A). The §4 displayed theorem binds the result via 'Env.bindInt env "result" rbody' with rbody bound by NOTHING — no '∀ r, stabilizes body env r →' hypothesis; only prose ('binds via Env.bindInt after stabilization') + the fuel₀ hint. For an env-dependent body no concrete value is computable at export time, so the prose cannot be implemented as a value. Pin: registry f(x)=g(x), g(x)=5 (dec-bounded, complete); body f(x) stabilizes to 5 (body_stabilizes_to_5) but is the bottom 0 at hint fuel 1 (rbody_at_hint_fuel_is_bottom); the wrong contract 'ens result == 0' DISCHARGES under the hint rendering (wrong_contract_certifies_with_underfuelled_rbody) and is REFUTED at the true value (wrong_contract_fails_at_true_value) — the #213 Int-bottom unsoundness recurs on the body side. Fix shape: quantify the result ('∀ r, stabilizes body env r → reqStable → ensStable at r').
